title: RTT Resonance Truth Correction Policy
description: Schema for a Correction Policy associated with an RTT Resonance Truth Service v0.1 Truth State. A Correction Policy governs permitted downstream response after evaluation. It does not determine the Truth State itself.

correction_policy_id.description: Stable identifier for the Correction Policy.

truth_state_id.description: Identifier of the Truth State to which this Correction Policy applies.

mode.description: Canonical v0.1 mode governing the permitted downstream response.

reason.description: Structured rationale explaining why this Correction mode applies.

maximum_adjustment.description: Optional maximum permitted adjustment where Correction has a meaningful numeric magnitude. Null is valid when Correction is nonnumeric or no maximum is defined.

adjustment_unit.description: Unit associated with maximum_adjustment when a numeric Correction boundary is defined.

requires_approval.description: Indicates whether downstream Correction requires approval from an external actor or authority.

approval_authority.description: Identifier or bounded description of the authority required to approve Correction, when applicable.

downstream_constraints.description: Additional constraints governing execution of the Correction. These constraints restrict downstream action and must not override the producing Truth State.

created_at.description: Timestamp at which the Correction Policy was created, when serialized independently.

metadata.description: Optional domain-specific or implementation metadata. Metadata must not override canonical Correction Policy fields.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the Correction decision.

evidence_references.description: Identifiers of Truth States, Drift States, Evaluations, Regimes, Evidence, or related objects supporting this Correction decision.

regime_rule.description: Optional governing Regime rule associated with the Correction decision.

constraint_type.description: Domain-specific type of downstream Correction constraint.

value.description: Optional domain-native value associated with the constraint. The meaning of this value is defined by constraint_type.

unit.description: Optional unit associated with the constraint value.

reason.message: Qualified temporal drift remains within the declared operating boundary and does not require local adjustment.
The temporal evidence is coherent and local drift remains inside the declared Regime boundary, permitting gradual correction.

downstream_constraints.description: Correction must remain gradual while the temporal state remains operationally accepted.

reason.message: Two independently supported temporal clusters remain unresolved. No single temporal correction may be applied from the fragmented evidence field.

downstream_constraints.description: Do not mutate the local clock toward either unresolved temporal cluster solely to manufacture one accepted state.

reason.message: No sufficiently qualified temporal state exists from which local clock correction can be justified.

downstream_constraints.description: No temporal correction may be derived from the current Evaluation.
